name: Replit Code
description:
Here is how to read the Replit Code config.json. The architecture class is MPTForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 2,560: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 32,768 × 2,560: each token id owns a vector of that width.

max_position_embeddings is 2,048 tokens — the context window in the config. There is no rope_scaling entry, so the rotary positions are used as-is.

vocab_size is 32,768. 32,768 is divisible by 256, the usual vocab-tiling grain. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

torch_dtype is float32.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/replit/replit-code-v1-3b/blob/main/config.json.
